messages:
sam: heads-up — starting config-only deploy in quiet window (22:30 PT). Sensitive knobs: routing weights, batch_size, request_timeout_ms. Pinning model=redwood/gptx-2.1-quant:v3 -> cfg id cfg-2026-3459. will stage 10% for 30m canary.

deploy-bot: RELEASE CREATED by sam: cfg-2026-3459
- type: config-only
- targets: routing, batching, timeouts
- canary: 10% -> 30m
- id: cfg-2026-3459

maria: ack — i'll watch latency/cost dashboards :eyes:

jen: quick ask: can we lower batch_size to 8? saw p99 jump when it's 16 on short seqs.

sam: good call. patching config now:
```
batch_size: 8
request_timeout_ms: 12000
routing_policy:
  primary: low-latency
  fallback: cost-prefer
```

deploy-bot: CONFIG PATCHED -> cfg-2026-3459-v2 (diff: batch_size 16 -> 8, timeout 15000 -> 12000)

ops-oncall: noting eu-west-1 p95 tail rising 2s after canary hits 20% — holding progression. pausing rollout.

sam: pausing now. rolling routing weight back to baseline while we investigate. initiating rollback for routing weights only.

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK STARTED by sam: cfg-2026-3459 rollback routing weights -> baseline. Canary frozen at 10%.

maria: thanks. i'll collect traces and open quick debugger session at 22:40.

kai: added note to release notes draft: "config-only attempt: lowered batch_size, tightened timeout; paused due to eu-west tail latency — rollback applied".

sam: after rollback, let's run canary again tomorrow morning with a slimmer traffic ramp and per-region cap. created a follow-up ticket: https://rwd.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2129

deploy-bot: ROLLBACK COMPLETED -> all active routing weights restored. config state: cfg-2026-3459-v1 active.

jen: small takeaway: consider per-region batch_size override so EU gets smaller batches.

maria: opening short postmortem doc and adding ops notes. thanks all :thumbsup:
